**Maintainer ruling (2026-08-09): C — the bespoke card wall retires.** `pm:queue`.

`/apps/:app/system` moves to a navigation/registry-driven entry; `SystemHubPage` (already `@deprecated`) and its hand-written card array, count logic, badge copy, and test surface are deleted. Per the card's own consolidated-decision list: **#3685 closes as not planned** (the 403-silence question is moot once the wall is gone — closed alongside this ruling), the transitional `'permissions'` badge copy question dies with the wall, and **#3670 is a PM wrap-up item independent of this ruling** — its two halves landed via PRs #3686/#3728; the executing seat verifies and closes it during implementation.

Rationale (three-axis): five repair rounds (#3670/#3679/#3680/#3686/#3655) in the card wall's short life are the measured maintenance cost of a hand-synced surface — that is the business case. The nav/registry is the repo's existing single source of truth; a parallel hand-written mirror of it re-drifts by construction. And bespoke hardcoded UI (name lists, count semantics, three-state shapes) is the form AI seats have repeatedly gotten wrong here and the hardest for gates to watch; registry-driven structure is wrong-proof by shape.

Implementation split (PM will sequence): intent is ruled here; the executing card covers the route landing, test-surface handover, and the #3670 verification/closure.

Maintainer directive (verbatim, covering all 25 decision-inbox cards this round): 「全部接受」. Recorded by PM session session_01LGRN2cSRfggfX9B2L83bQc. Veto window open — comment to overturn.

### Findings, each with its disposition

- **Discoverability, from the reviewer and not disclosed in the PR.** The wall was the only in-app producer of `system/audit-log` (`AuditLogPage`), `system/ai-approvals` (`AiPendingActionsPage`) and `/apps/:app/developer` (`DeveloperHubPage`). After this PR those three routes stay reachable by URL, but nothing in objectui or the framework navigation links to them. This follows the ruling's design, since navigation is the single source of truth. Still, each page needs a navigation entry or its own retirement ⇒ **to be carded by the seat**; the card number will be recorded on the seat post.
- Framework `nav_settings_hub` is gated on `manage_platform_settings`, while objectui's 7 senders are ungated. A caller without that permission gets a server-filtered hub (reduced or empty), not a 403 ⇒ **Acceptance notes**.
- Stale comments, all comment-only:
  - `apps/console/src/registerAccountComponents.tsx` still says the System Hub links to `/system/profile`;
  - app-shell sidebar/QuickActions comments still call the URL "the system hub";
  - `SystemLandingRedirect`'s comment says no producer sends search or hash, but a `/system?…` bookmark does.

  ⇒ **Acceptance notes**.
- Governed docs still describe `SystemHubPage`: `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md`, `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`, and 7 `ROADMAP.md` lines ⇒ governed surface, owed to a seat docs PR.
- The PR assignee is not set; the dev's `label-write` was refused by its classifier ⇒ reported to the maintainer.

### State

`ready` and auto-merge (squash) go through the relay ops `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, run right after this ACCEPT as the write budget allows.
